C001_RECENT_RANGE.role: 未来3日日内振幅连续预测，不是下跌概率或安全持仓阈值
C001_RECENT_RANGE.formula: range_n(T)=mean((High-Low)/Close,T-n+1..T); 主检查n=5，邻域3/7/10完整报告，均属一个信息族。
C001_RECENT_RANGE.label: range3=mean(log(High/Low),T+1..T+3)
C001_RECENT_RANGE.status: SUPPORTED for continuous within-pool amplitude information only

C002_PRICE_PRESSURE.role: 短期反转线索，独立收益增量尚未确立
C002_PRICE_PRESSURE.formula: vwap_dev=Close/(Amount/Volume)-1; body=log(Close/Open); ret1=log(Close/Close[-1]); close_location=(2Close-High-Low)/(High-Low). 核心vwap_dev方向每训练折均负。
C002_PRICE_PRESSURE.label: open1=Open[T+2]/Open[T+1]-1
C002_PRICE_PRESSURE.status: association supported; unique incremental role INSUFFICIENT_DATA

C003_CONTINUATION.role: 本次固定趋势信息集的增量检验负结果
C003_CONTINUATION.formula: ret5/20/60、efficiency20/60、ma_dev20，加固定ret5/vol20基线；训练内标准化、ridge alpha=10。
C003_CONTINUATION.status: INEFFECTIVE in tested representation, not universal mechanism falsification

C004_RANGE_SLOPE.role: 多日环境线索，当前证据不足
C004_RANGE_SLOPE.formula: tsfresh linear_trend(attr=slope) on last20 daily (High-Low)/Close observations; 对照60日同类斜率。
C004_RANGE_SLOPE.label: open3/open5

C005_DUPLICATE_INFO.role: 避免把同源变换计为新信息
C005_DUPLICATE_INFO.formula: ts20 range mean == range20; ts20 return mean proportional ret20; ts20 return standard_deviation == vol20; ts20 volume_change mean proportional volume_change20; ts60 range mean == range60。
C005_DUPLICATE_INFO.status: REDUNDANT; five perfect rank-equivalent pairs verified
